content: rustc-hash 2.1.3 (2026-07-02), MSRV 1.77 declared, passes 1.80 gate. FxHasher fastest raw u64 hash (0.67ns Xeon, 0.41ns M2) but weak avalanche: foldhash README documents u64hibits lookup pathology 67.72ns vs foldhash 1.77ns on M2. Risky for structured 2-bit-packed k-mer keys where clustering lengthens probe sequences; foldhash preferred for the counting table.
